title: Deleted entries: never exported, purged after 24 hours
lead: Owner decision (2026-10-03): deleted entries are excluded from every export and removed from the device 24 hours after deletion.
findings_note: BackupCodec.kt:46-57 (encode writes soft-deleted entries and their notes); TrackerRepository.kt:104-109 (soft delete only, never purged)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing undo behaviour (S39), the CSV format (S17 already skips deleted entries), and `PRIVACY.md` (S20 writes the claim).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- Deleting an entry only sets `isDeleted = true`. The row, including any note, stays in the database forever and is written into every JSON backup, so "deleted" text leaves the device in every export.
- Soft delete exists for Undo (S39). The undo snackbar lasts seconds, so 24 hours is a generous window.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM, in `BackupCodecTest`:
- `encode omits deleted entries` (a bundle with one active and one deleted entry encodes one entry)

Instrumented, in `TrackerDaoTest`:
- `purgeDeletedEntries removes only deleted entries older than the cutoff` (three entries: active and old, deleted and old, deleted and recent; after the purge only the first and third remain, and it returns 1)
- `importBackup skips entries marked deleted`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. `BackupCodec.encode`: write only entries with `isDeleted == false`. Keep writing the `isDeleted` field (always `false`) so older app versions can still read the file. `decode` keeps accepting `isDeleted` so older backups still import.
2. `TrackerRepository.importBackup`: skip imported entries with `isDeleted == true` (do not insert them).
3. DAO: `@Query("DELETE FROM entries WHERE isDeleted = 1 AND updatedAtEpochMs < :cutoffEpochMs") suspend fun purgeDeletedEntries(cutoffEpochMs: Long): Int`. Repository: `suspend fun purgeDeletedEntries(now: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): Int = trackerDao.purgeDeletedEntries(now - PURGE_AFTER_MS)` with `const val PURGE_AFTER_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L` in a companion object.
4. `ConsecutorApp`: add `val appScope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)` if S43 has not already added it, and in `onCreate` launch `runCatching { repository.purgeDeletedEntries() }` on it. A failure must not crash startup.
5. Update tests that expected deleted entries to round-trip: `BackupCodecTest` decode tests that read a fixture with a deleted entry stay (decode still accepts it); any test that encodes a deleted entry and expects it back must now expect it to be absent. Do the same in `BackupCodecInstrumentedTest`.
6. `DEVELOPERS.md` "Persistence Notes": one line, "Deleted entries are kept for 24 hours (for Undo), then removed at the next app start; they are never written to backups or CSV."

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes, and the instrumented tests pass (`./gradlew pixel6api34DebugAndroidTest` once S55 has landed, otherwise `connectedDebugAndroidTest`).
- Manual: add an entry with the note "secret", delete it, export a backup: the file does not contain "secret". Undo still works within the snackbar.
